rows.whatChanged: This family existed before this lane and did not meet the builder contract. Its production-field-map was written in a schema the completeness verifier refuses as unauditable, it carried no participant-instructions.md and no byte-proof record, and — the substantive defect — three of the participant's own facts were blank on the filing because JD-CR-202 prints its column headings a row above its inputs and the shared caption harvest read every field one row out. Captions are now measured and re-checked against the pinned binary on every build; the name, e-mail and phone are written; the family carries a contract-readable map, a byte-proof record, participant instructions and a build status.

artifacts.unfittableNote: The boundary fixture's 70-character name and 46-character docket number do not fit their boxes at the minimum readable font, so they are refused rather than clipped. That is the boundary fixture doing its job; the canonical fixture writes both.

findingsRaisedForOthers: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs harvests the whole header line on any form that prints its column headings above its inputs. Read here, never edited.

rowKeyOf in scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/completeness-contract.mjs reads a trailing [n] in a field name as a repeating-row index, which groups every field of an Adobe LiveCycle form into one phantom row. It also consults only classifyField and never a blank's declared disposition, so a correctly disclosed REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING blank beside any written cell trips it.

The printed name on the defendant's own signature row is left blank here because JD-CR-202 is sworn before an officer, which differs from vt_seal_misdemeanor-set's practice on a form that is not sworn. Flagged for counsel, not settled by this lane.

BLOCKING for the fleet, owner of the Captain branch: scripts/lib/pdf-page-raster.mjs does not exist at the current Captain head (5f144ec). The module is at scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs, and FIFTEEN builders on that branch still import the old path, so none of them can run there: ak-courtview, ak-tf805, co_motion_seal_nonconviction, co_multiple_conviction_seal, co_pardoned_conviction_seal, ky_void_seal_controlled_substance, md_second_chance_shielding, me-seal-prost, mi_setaside_marihuana, or_conviction_setaside, pa_age70_deceased, pa_pardon_expungement, va_seal_petition_misdemeanor, vt_exp_decriminalized, vt_seal_nonconviction. Two builders (ak-tf800, vt_seal_misdemeanor) already import the new path, so the migration is half done. A one-line re-export shim at the old path fixes all fifteen at once. This lane changed only its OWN builders, which now try the new path and fall back to the old, catching ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND and nothing else; the other builders are not this lane's to edit.

BLOCKING for the raster gate, owner of the packet-factory builder contract: assembled packet PDFs are NOT byte-reproducible. PDFDocument.create() stamps /CreationDate and /ModDate from the wall clock, and save({updateMetadata:false}) stops those being refreshed but not being set. Two builds of identical inputs were measured differing in exactly six bytes, all of them timestamp digits. A RASTER_PASS bound to one build's SHA-256 is therefore invalidated by a rebuild that changed nothing, which is the opposite of what a hash-bound gate is for. The fix is two lines before save: setCreationDate(new Date(0)) and setModificationDate(new Date(0)). This lane applied it to the three families no VF lane has been assigned, and proved reproducibility by rebuilding and comparing. It did NOT apply it to its earlier families: VF-SRC-A and VF-SRC-B are reading those now, and moving bytes under a verifier mid-read is worse than leaving a known non-determinism in place for the Captain to sequence.

document.laneNote: The Captain rebased shiftBaseSha to 2e6ca51b at 09:51:26Z, after this lane's families were built on the previous base 09b741ad. The shared machinery this lane depends on is unchanged between the two: completeness-contract.mjs, the finalizer, the field semantics, the anchor capture, the rule lines and the corpus index are all identical, so the counters in these rows were computed against the same contract the new base carries. What DID change is that scripts/lib/pdf-page-raster.mjs moved; see findingsRaisedForOthers. This branch was not reset onto the new base, because resetting would discard five commits of finished, pushed returns and the rebase reason given in the shift file — verifiers rebasing onto a base missing the integration waves — does not apply to a builder whose preflight already reads 15/15.
